reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Silicon Valley icon, Marc Andreessen.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Silicon Valley icon, Marc Andreessen. Before co-founding the legendary venture capital firm, Andreessen Horowitz, Marc was an early pioneer of the internet. At age 22, he built Mosaic, the first widely adopted web browser and the technology that underpinned Netscape Communications.

key_points.text: Marc was an early proponent of cloud computing, social networks, and the software business model.
In each case, Marc seemed to be well ahead of the crowd.
During our conversation, we explore how software is making the world better, how slow sectors like education, healthcare, and housing are eating the economy.
